ValidationRule.description: For the Prospero_Client record type, if the selected type is not Local Authority, Council, or Private Client, then either Council_Lookup__c OR Local_Authority__c must be populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospero_Client",
NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Health_Social_Care_Type__c, "Local Authority"), ISPICKVAL(Health_Social_Care_Type__c, "Council"), ISPICKVAL( Health_Social_Care_Type__c, "Private Client (Individual Adult, Directed Family)" ), ISPICKVAL(Teaching_Type__c, "Local Authority"), ISPICKVAL(Teaching_Type__c, "Council"), ISPICKVAL( Teaching_Type__c, "Private Client" ) ) ),
AND( ISBLANK(Council_Lookup__c), ISBLANK(Local_Authority__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must add the Local Authority and a Council for this Type of Client
